class.name: GCASPacker
class.brief_description: Creates GCAS packages that can be loaded into a running project.

method.name: add_base_pack
method.description: Makes the package a patch for the GCAS package at [param base_path]: chunks already stored in it are referenced instead of being stored again. The base package must be loaded before the patch.

method.name: add_export_layout_provider
method.description: Registers a layout provider used when exporting projects to GCAS packages. Editor plugins can use it to control how the files they create are split into chunks.

method.name: add_file
method.description: Adds the file at [param source_path] to the package, as [param target_path] (for example [code]res://folder/file.res[/code]). If [param uid] is valid, it is registered with [ResourceUID] when the package is loaded.

method.name: add_file_from_buffer
method.description: Adds a file with the contents [param data] to the package, as [param target_path] (for example [code]res://folder/file.res[/code]). If [param uid] is valid, it is registered with [ResourceUID] when the package is loaded.

method.name: add_file_removal
method.description: Registers the removal of [param target_path]: when the package is loaded, the file is removed from the packages loaded before it.

method.name: add_layout_provider
method.description: Adds a layout provider, used to split the files it handles into chunks (for example at the boundaries of the data read by streaming).

method.name: flush
method.description: Writes the package. Must be called after adding all the files.

method.name: remove_export_layout_provider
method.description: Removes a layout provider registered with [method add_export_layout_provider].

method.name: start
method.description: Starts writing a package to [param path]. [param compression_level] is the Zstandard compression level used for chunks (from [code]1[/code] to [code]22[/code]), which only affects the time it takes to create the package, not the time it takes to read it.
